items.title: Consume an Alcoholic Beverage
items.detail: Get from a C.A.M.P. Brewing Vat or another player's C.A.M.P.

items.title: Collect Caps
items.detail: Sell looted weapons, junk, chems, or food to a vendor for fastest completion.

items.title: Collect Energy Ammo
items.detail: Take from stash, craft at Tinker's Workbench, or loot from energy weapon users.

items.title: Collect a Blood pack
items.detail: Fast travel to Summersville; check the Laundromat table next to jukebox and first aid boxes.

items.title: Kill an Enemy in the Cranberry Bog Region
items.detail: Fast travel to Crimson Prospect for Blood Eagles.

items.title: Kill an Enemy in the Toxic Valley Region
items.detail: Fast travel to Grafton Steel for a dense concentration of Super Mutants.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Concrete
items.detail: Craft Bulk Concrete at Tinker's Workbench, then scrap it.

items.title: Build a Turret or Trap in a Workshop or C.A.M.P.
items.detail: Place any turret or trap under Defense in build menu; Punji Board requires only 4 steel and 8 wood.

items.title: Harvest a Prickeye
items.detail: Fast travel to Tycoon Lake in Burning Springs; look for unusual orange bulbs.

items.title: Kill Insects
items.detail: Giant Teapot for bees via Strange Brew quest, or Tanagra Town cave for up to ten Cave Crickets.

items.title: Kill The Reborn Pint-Sized Slasher
items.detail: Appears as uninvited guest at Head Hunt event in final stage; check Highway Town Bounty Board.

items.title: Kill a Cultist
items.detail: Fast travel to Point Pleasant for up to 33 Cultists; target head with V.A.T.S. for quick kills.

items.title: Repair Armor, Weapons, or Power Armor
items.detail: Grab a Protest Sign, hit an enemy to degrade it, repair at workbench with 1 wood.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Acid
items.detail: Craft Bulk Acid at Tinker's Workbench and scrap it.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Crystal
items.detail: Scrap Crystal liquor decanters and Floater freezer pus sacs; find decanters at Clancy Manor.

items.title: Travel on foot (KM)
items.detail: Fast travel does not count; sprint over open ground for fastest distance, holster weapon to move faster.

events.name: Gold Rush and Double Mutations
events.description: Weekend event offering bonus caps and double mutation rates on creatures.

events.name: Mutated Public Events
events.description: Public events spawn with mutations during this period with special rewards.

events.name: Double XP Weekend
events.description: Experience points earned are doubled during this weekend event.

events.name: Treasure Hunter and Double Mutations
events.description: Weekend featuring Treasure Hunter enemies with increased mutation rates and unique rewards.

events.name: Holiday Scorched
events.description: Seasonal event with holiday-themed scorched enemies offering festive rewards.
